context: A Kansai chef and a barista swap festival prep tips
purpose: Teach: レモン/キャベツ/ブラウン/ミラー/妖精/神秘/パレード/見舞い

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: アオイさん、夏のパレード、何屋台出すん?
lines.en: Aoi, what are you running at the summer parade booth?
lines.style: Warm, open curiosity in Kansai accent. Leaning in with genuine interest. Relaxed pace, no pressure. The tone of someone who wants to help.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: レモンドリンクと、キャベツチップス。テーブルはブラウンで統一。
lines.en: Lemonade and cabbage chips. Everything brown — one unified look.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to herself. Speaking with quiet care about the details she's already considered. Soft landing on each item, no rush.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ミラー設置して、夜の雰囲気神秘的にしたらどうや?
lines.en: What if you set up a mirror and made the whole thing feel mysterious at night?
lines.style: Bright idea landing mid-thought. Animated Kansai lilt on the question. Building enthusiasm without overselling. Light, collaborative energy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いい案ですね。スタッフは妖精コスプレで盛り上げます。
lines.en: That's a great idea. We'll get the staff in fairy costumes to really make it shine.
lines.style: Brightening noticeably. Accepting the idea and already running with it. Slightly faster pace, warmer — she's imagining it. Genuine enthusiasm, not performed.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 病気のお父さんへのお見舞いも兼ねて、屋台寄ってもらおか。
lines.en: And while we're at it, we can get people to stop by the booth on their way to visit your dad.
lines.style: Shift to gentleness. The Kansai warmth becomes tender, not dismissive of the weight beneath. Steady, offering without making it heavy. Quiet care in the reframing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ありがとうございます、嬉しいです。
lines.en: Thank you so much. That really means a lot to me.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude with real feeling underneath. Slight vocal catch — not breaking, just genuine. Soft close, trailing gently. The moment she lets him see she needed this.
